entries.zh: 保安跟我说，你想了解大福以前的事。
entries.en: The guard told me you want to know about Dafu's past.

entries.zh: 大福从医院回来后，起初还是躲着人。
entries.en: After returning from the hospital, Dafu still kept away from people at first.

entries.zh: 大福恢复后，也是她把大福带回社区。
entries.en: After Dafu recovered, she was also the one who brought him back to the community.

entries.zh: 大福是什么时候开始天天往这边跑的？
entries.en: When did Dafu start coming this way every day?

entries.zh: 您当时为什么连续几天给大福送吃的？
entries.en: Why did you bring Dafu food for several days in a row at the time?

entries.zh: 勒着你的东西是什么感觉？你还记得吗？
entries.en: What did the thing constricting you feel like? Do you still remember?

entries.zh: 医院检查后认为需要尽快进行颈部手术。
entries.en: After examining him, the hospital decided neck surgery was needed as soon as possible.

entries.zh: 大福没有固定主人，社区中有多人照顾。
entries.en: Dafu has no fixed owner; several people in the community look after him.

entries.zh: 大福记得有一个女人曾经给它带来食物。
entries.en: Dafu remembers a woman who used to bring him food.

entries.zh: 老式木质长椅，看上去至少服役十年了。
entries.en: An old wooden bench that looks like it's served at least ten years.

entries.zh: 获得情报——“大福成为保安猫的时间”
entries.en: New Clue: When Dafu became the security cat

entries.zh: 获得情报——“社区中有多人照顾大福”
entries.en: New Clue: Multiple people in the community look after Dafu

entries.zh: 请问您明天下午方便接受一个短采访吗？
entries.en: Would you be free for a short interview tomorrow afternoon?

entries.zh: 那时候不会像现在一样主动靠近保安亭。
entries.en: Back then he wouldn't approach the guard booth on his own like he does now.

entries.zh: 不知道为什么有点想喝奶茶了......
entries.en: For some reason I'm craving milk tea......

entries.zh: 伤口存在坏死和严重感染，需要尽快处理。
entries.en: The wound had necrosis and a serious infection—it needed prompt treatment.

entries.zh: 保安确认，大福康复后也是由她送回社区。
entries.en: The guard confirmed that after Dafu recovered, she was also the one who brought him back.

entries.zh: 后来又有一段时间没有力气、不想吃东西。
entries.en: Later there was another stretch when he had no energy and didn't want to eat.

entries.zh: 塑料收纳箱改造的猫屋，比出租屋还精致。
entries.en: A plastic storage bin remade into a cat house—nicer than a studio apartment.

entries.zh: 它没有长期住进女人家里，但不知道原因。
entries.en: He never moved into the woman's home long-term, but doesn't know why.

entries.zh: 手术、住院和后续治疗总费用接近一万元。
entries.en: Surgery, hospitalization, and follow-up care totaled nearly ten thousand yuan.

entries.zh: 醒来后，原本勒住脖子的东西已经不见了。
entries.en: When he woke up, the thing that had been constricting his neck was gone.

entries.zh: 大福没有离开，逐渐固定在保安亭附近生活。
entries.en: Dafu didn't leave—he gradually settled near the guard booth.

entries.zh: 当前目标更新——“向保安询问大福的情况”
entries.en: Current objective updated — "Ask the guard about Dafu"

entries.zh: 当年把大福送去治疗的人是社区居民林女士。
entries.en: The person who took Dafu for treatment back then was community resident Ms. Lin.

entries.zh: 快递柜顶留有橘色猫毛，是大福常待的位置。
entries.en: Orange cat fur on top of the parcel lockers—Dafu's usual spot.

entries.zh: 林女士家中已经有四只猫，还需要照顾女儿。
entries.en: Ms. Lin already had four cats at home, and a daughter to look after.

entries.zh: 水碗里装着大半碗清水，上面飘着几根猫毛。
entries.en: The water bowl is half full; a few cat hairs float on top.

entries.zh: 获得情报——“大福经常在保安亭附近活动”
entries.en: New Clue: Dafu often hangs around near the guard booth

entries.zh: 获得情报——“大福通常在下午四五点出现”
entries.en: New Clue: Dafu usually appears around 4–5 p.m.

entries.zh: 保安叔叔抬头看了眼快递柜，又看了一眼时间。
entries.en: Security Guard looks up at the parcel lockers, then checks the time.

entries.zh: 具体怎么伤的、后来怎么治的，我就不清楚了。
entries.en: How he got hurt exactly, and how he was treated later—that part I don't know.

entries.zh: 再后来不知道什么时候，它就开始往这上面躺。
entries.en: Sometime after that, he started lying up here.

entries.zh: 决定把大福送回社区之前，您考虑了哪些情况？
entries.en: Before deciding to send Dafu back to the community, what did you take into account?

entries.zh: 小凌往灌木丛里看了一眼，但是什么都没看见。
entries.en: Ling glances into the bushes, but sees nothing.

entries.zh: 用大福提供的线索，向保安打听当年的救助者。
entries.en: Use Dafu's clues to ask the guard about who rescued him.

entries.zh: 下雨就不知道钻哪去了，反正吃饭的时候会出来。
entries.en: When it rains, who knows where he ducks off to—but he always comes out at mealtime.

entries.zh: 十几分钟后，小凌的手机收到一条新的好友申请。
entries.en: A little over ten minutes later, Ling's phone gets a new friend request.

entries.zh: 挂牌提醒不要倒剩饭，并补了一行：奶茶不算水。
entries.en: The sign says no leftovers—and adds: milk tea is not water.

entries.zh: 保安只知道它因此被人送去治疗，具体情况不清楚。
entries.en: The guard only knows he was taken for treatment because of that; the details are unclear.

entries.zh: 后来有居民换水、添粮、搭猫屋，保安也会照看它。
entries.en: Later residents changed the water, topped up the food, and built a cat house; the guard looks after him too.

entries.zh: 大福原本就在槐安社区活动，社区也已有固定投喂。
entries.en: Dafu was already active in Huai'an Community, which already had regular feeding.

entries.zh: 大福记得自己曾经被人抓住，并被带离熟悉的社区。
entries.en: Dafu remembers being caught and taken away from the community he knew.

entries.zh: 采访大福时，可以问问它以前会不会靠近这里的人。
entries.en: When interviewing Dafu, you can ask whether he used to approach people around here.

entries.zh: （还缺少相关线索。先问清当初是谁救助的大福。）
entries.en: (Not enough leads yet. First find out who rescued Dafu.)

entries.zh: 其实我一直很好奇，猫会不会把水里自己的毛喝下去。
entries.en: I've always wondered whether cats end up drinking their own fur out of the water.

entries.zh: 后来有人每天给它送吃的，它慢慢就往门口这边来了。
entries.en: Later someone brought him food every day, and he gradually started coming toward the gate.

entries.zh: 大福不知道为什么自己会被送回来，需要询问林女士。
entries.en: Dafu doesn't know why he was sent back—need to ask Ms. Lin.

entries.zh: 大福曾因颈部受伤被送医，但保安并不了解具体经过。
entries.en: Dafu was taken to a vet for a neck injury, but the guard doesn't know the details.

entries.zh: 大福记得最后是那个反复送食物的女人把它带回社区。
entries.en: Dafu remembers that in the end, the woman who kept bringing food was the one who brought him back.

entries.zh: 公司楼下要十八。突然发现了一个值得调查的社会议题。
entries.en: Eighteen downstairs at the office. Suddenly I've found a social issue worth investigating.

entries.zh: 发现伤势持续恶化后，她联系有救助经验的人协助抓捕。
entries.en: After noticing the injury kept getting worse, she contacted people with rescue experience to help catch him.

entries.zh: 大福经常趴在社区入口的快递柜上，但当前并不在附近。
entries.en: Dafu often lies on the parcel lockers at the gate, but isn't nearby right now.

entries.zh: 林女士连续四晚带食物寻找大福，每次放下后主动退远。
entries.en: Ms. Lin spent four nights in a row bringing food to find Dafu, stepping back each time after setting it down.

entries.zh: 几个猫碗并排放着，其中一个还有少量猫粮。碗底很干净。
entries.en: Several cat bowls sit side by side; one still has a little kibble. The bottoms are clean.

entries.zh: 大福（橘猫）经常和另一只狸花猫一起吃饭、休息和活动。
entries.en: Dafu (the orange cat) often eats, rests, and hangs out with another tabby.

entries.zh: 小凌刚往前靠近两步，狸花猫立刻抬起头，警惕地看向她。
entries.en: Ling takes just two steps closer, and the tabby immediately lifts its head, watching her warily.

entries.zh: 林女士确认社区有人持续照看后，将大福送回原活动区域。
entries.en: After confirming someone in the community was still looking after him, Ms. Lin returned Dafu to his original area.

entries.zh: 任务更新——“明天下午15:00前往咖啡馆采访林女士”
entries.en: Quest updated — "Tomorrow at 15:00, go to the café to interview Ms. Lin"

entries.zh: 大福不知道她是谁。也许可以拿这些特征去问认识大福的人。
entries.en: Dafu doesn't know who she is. Maybe these details can be taken to people who know Dafu.

entries.zh: 她认为自己的空间、精力和经济能力无法长期承担第五只猫。
entries.en: She felt her space, energy, and finances couldn't sustain a fifth cat long-term.

entries.zh: 林女士看到大福脖子上缠着一根较粗的麻绳，并且已经出血。
entries.en: Ms. Lin saw a fairly thick hemp rope wound around Dafu's neck—and it was already bleeding.

entries.zh: 林女士第一次发现大福时，它非常警惕，完全无法直接靠近。
entries.en: The first time Ms. Lin found Dafu, he was so wary she couldn't get near him at all.

entries.zh: 没有固定主人，多名居民会投喂、换水；保安也会顺手照看。
entries.en: No fixed owner; several residents feed him and change the water; the guard looks after him when he can.

entries.zh: 狸花猫迅速起身，一头钻进旁边的灌木丛，只剩树叶轻轻晃动。
entries.en: The tabby springs up and dives into the nearby bushes; only the leaves keep swaying gently.

entries.zh: 一只狸花猫趴在灌木丛边的草地上晒太阳，前爪交叠，眯着眼睛。
entries.en: A tabby lies on the grass by the bushes, sunbathing, front paws crossed, eyes half-closed.

entries.zh: 社区内设有长期维护的投喂点，附近居民可能了解流浪猫的情况。
entries.en: There's a long-maintained feeding spot; nearby residents may know about the strays.

entries.zh: 看来这里虽然有人固定照顾它们，但不代表它们会随便亲近陌生人。
entries.en: Looks like even with regular care, that doesn't mean they'll cozy up to strangers.

entries.zh: 阳光渐渐西斜。保安叔叔回到岗亭，小凌坐到附近的长椅上等大福。
entries.en: The sun sinks westward. Security Guard returns to the booth; Ling sits on a nearby bench to wait for Dafu.

entries.zh: 没有人看到麻绳最初是如何套上去的，目前无法确认是否存在人为伤害。
entries.en: No one saw how the rope first got on; whether there was intentional harm remains unconfirmed.

entries.zh: 下面还有一行明显是后来补上的：不要倒水之外的液体！！！奶茶不算水！
entries.en: Below, a line clearly added later: Do not pour liquids other than water!!! Milk tea does not count as water!

entries.zh: 这样吧，一会儿你先看看大福。我晚点帮你问问那个人愿不愿意接受采访。
entries.en: How about this—go check on Dafu for now. Later I'll ask that person if they'd be willing to be interviewed.

entries.zh: 大福只能记得身体感受，无法解释发生了什么。需要询问当时参与救助的人。
entries.en: Dafu only remembers how his body felt, not what happened. Need to ask the people involved in the rescue.

entries.zh: 忽然，一名穿着保安制服的中年男人从保安亭内走出，将保温杯放在窗台上。
entries.en: Suddenly a middle-aged man in a security uniform steps out of the guard booth and sets a thermos on the windowsill.

entries.zh: 那就行。以前胆子小，现在好多了，但不认识的人靠太近，它还是会躲着你。
entries.en: That'll do. He used to be timid; he's better now, but if strangers get too close, he'll still keep away.

entries.zh: 以前这附近猫也不少。它那时候又怕人，看见人就躲，我哪分得出来哪只是它。
entries.en: There were plenty of cats around here before. He was so shy back then—bolting at the sight of people—how was I supposed to tell which one was which?

entries.zh: 社区入口旁立着一排快递柜。柜顶铺着一块折叠纸板，上面残留着少量橘色猫毛。
entries.en: A row of parcel lockers stands by the community entrance. A folded cardboard sheet lies on top, with a few orange cat hairs left on it.

entries.zh: 面对费用和不确定的结果，林女士承认自己曾犹豫过是否继续治疗，但最后仍选择继续。
entries.en: Facing the cost and uncertain outcome, Ms. Lin admits she hesitated over whether to continue treatment—but in the end she chose to go on.

entries.zh: 明天下午三点左右我有空。小区南门外有家咖啡馆，就约在那里吧，人少一点，方便说话。
entries.en: I'm free around three tomorrow afternoon. There's a café just outside the community's south gate—let's meet there. Quieter, easier to talk.

entries.zh: 大福原本只是附近活动的流浪猫。接受救治并被放归后，它才逐渐开始在保安亭附近长期活动。
entries.en: Dafu used to just roam nearby. After treatment and release, he slowly settled around the guard booth.

entries.zh: 她还住这儿，有时候还会过来看大福。你想采访她的话，我先帮你问一声。她愿意的话，再把联系方式给你。
entries.en: She still lives here, and she comes by to see Dafu sometimes. If you want to interview her, I'll ask first. If she's willing, I'll pass along her contact info.

entries.zh: 我今天已经在社区看过大福，也跟保安了解了一些情况。还有些它当时受伤、治疗和后来送回社区的细节，想跟您核实一下。
entries.en: I've already seen Dafu in the community today, and learned a bit from the guard. There are still some details about the injury, the treatment, and how he was sent back—I'd like to verify those with you.

entries.zh: 一张老式木质长椅靠着步道摆放。绿色金属扶手已经有些掉漆，露出下面发灰的铁锈；几块木板被晒得颜色深浅不一，其中一块还微微翘起。
entries.en: An old wooden bench sits by the walkway. The green metal armrests are peeling, showing gray rust underneath; the planks have bleached unevenly in the sun, and one is slightly warped.

entries.zh: 挂牌上用记号笔写着：请不要把人类吃的剩饭倒在这里。猫粮少量添加，吃完再补，不然放久了会变质。水脏了的话麻烦帮忙换一下，谢谢。
entries.en: A sign written in marker reads: Please don't dump human leftovers here. Add cat food a little at a time—refill when it's gone, or it'll spoil. If the water's dirty, please change it. Thank you.

entries.zh: 林姐。我们小区的住户。大福脖子受伤的时候，是她找人抓住它，送去医院的。后来也是她把大福送回来的。具体怎么回事，你得问她。我也只知道个大概。
entries.en: Ms. Lin. A resident of our community. When Dafu's neck was hurt, she got people to catch him and take him to the hospital. Later she brought Dafu back too. For the full story, you'll have to ask her. I only know the rough outline.

entries.zh: 猫屋是用塑料收纳箱改造的，外面罩着一层裁剪过的防水板，接缝处贴了好几道胶带，屋顶还压着两块砖，防止被风吹翻。猫屋里铺着一张旧毛毯，表面已经被抓得起了球。
entries.en: The cat house is a converted plastic storage bin, covered with cut waterproof board, seams sealed with several strips of tape, and two bricks on the roof to keep the wind from flipping it. Inside lies an old blanket, already pilled from scratching.

entries.zh: 今日在岗
entries.en: On duty today

entries.zh: 大福从前很怕人
entries.en: Dafu used to fear people

entries.zh: 大福脖子的伤
entries.en: The wound on Dafu's neck

entries.zh: 消失的麻绳
entries.en: The rope that vanished

entries.zh: 麻绳嵌进了皮肉
entries.en: Rope embedded in flesh

entries.zh: 连续四晚投喂
entries.en: Four nights of feeding

entries.zh: 抓捕与送医
entries.en: Capture and hospital

entries.zh: 手术以后又确诊猫瘟
entries.en: Panleukopenia after surgery

entries.zh: 接近一万元
entries.en: Nearly ten thousand yuan

entries.zh: 确实犹豫过
entries.en: She did hesitate

entries.zh: 家里已经有四只猫
entries.en: Four cats already at home

entries.zh: 救治和收养是两件事
entries.en: Rescue and adoption are different

entries.zh: 回到槐安社区
entries.en: Back to Huai'an Community

entries.zh: 没有主人的大福
entries.en: Dafu with no owner

entries.zh: 狸花猫伙伴
entries.en: Tabby companion

entries.zh: 麻绳来源无法确认
entries.en: Rope source unconfirmed

entries.zh: 大福经常在下午四五点来到保安亭，吃完东西后趴在快递柜上休息。
entries.en: Dafu often shows up at the guard booth around 4–5 p.m., eats, then naps on the parcel lockers.

entries.zh: 大福被救助前非常怕人，只要有人靠近便会逃跑。
entries.en: Before rescue, Dafu was terrified of people—anyone approaching made him bolt.

entries.zh: 大福记得脖子长期被某种很紧的东西勒着，而且无法自行弄掉。
entries.en: Dafu remembers something tight around his neck for a long time, impossible to shake off.

entries.zh: 大福记得自己在陌生的地方睡了一觉，醒来后，原本勒住脖子的东西已经消失。
entries.en: Dafu remembers sleeping somewhere unfamiliar; when he woke, the thing around his neck was gone.

entries.zh: 医院检查发现，一根粗麻绳已经深深嵌入大福颈部，伤口出现坏死和严重感染。
entries.en: The hospital found a thick hemp rope deeply embedded in Dafu's neck, with necrosis and severe infection.

entries.zh: 林女士连续四晚带着罐头寻找大福，每次放下食物后都会主动退远。
entries.en: Ms. Lin spent four nights bringing canned food to find Dafu, stepping back each time after setting it down.

entries.zh: 大福伤势持续恶化后，林女士联系有救助经验的人协助抓捕，并将它送往医院。
entries.en: As the injury worsened, Ms. Lin called experienced rescuers to help catch Dafu and take him to the hospital.

entries.zh: 大福完成颈部手术后，在住院第三天又被确诊猫瘟，需要继续住院治疗。
entries.en: After neck surgery, Dafu was diagnosed with panleukopenia on day three and had to stay longer.

entries.zh: 大福的手术、住院和猫瘟治疗总费用接近一万元。
entries.en: Surgery, hospitalization, and panleukopenia treatment cost nearly ten thousand yuan in total.

entries.zh: 面对不断增加的费用和不确定的治疗结果，林女士承认自己曾考虑过是否继续治疗。
entries.en: Facing rising costs and uncertain outcomes, Ms. Lin admits she considered whether to continue treatment.

entries.zh: 林女士家中已经有四只猫，还需要照顾女儿，无法长期承担第五只猫。
entries.en: Ms. Lin already has four cats and a daughter to care for—she can't take on a fifth long-term.

entries.zh: 林女士认为，自己有能力在当时救治大福，并不代表有能力长期收养第五只猫。
entries.en: Ms. Lin believes being able to treat Dafu then does not mean she can adopt a fifth cat for good.

entries.zh: 大福康复后，林女士将它送回原本活动的槐安社区。
entries.en: After Dafu recovered, Ms. Lin returned him to Huai'an Community, where he used to roam.

entries.zh: 大福没有固定主人，但有居民为它换水、投喂、清洗猫碗和维护猫屋。
entries.en: Dafu has no fixed owner, but residents change his water, feed him, wash bowls, and maintain the cat house.

entries.zh: 大福（橘猫）后来经常与另一只狸花猫一起吃饭、休息，并在晚上结伴活动。
entries.en: Dafu (the orange cat) often eats and rests with a tabby, and they roam together at night.

entries.zh: 没有人看到麻绳如何套上大福的脖子，目前无法确认是否存在人为伤害。
entries.en: No one saw how the rope got on Dafu's neck; deliberate harm cannot be confirmed.

entries.zh: 文章发出去以后，偶尔会有人来问，大福今天有没有上班。
entries.en: After the article came out, people would occasionally stop by to ask if Dafu was on duty that day.

entries.zh: 但大福并不知道自己成了报道里的主角。它还是按照自己的时间出现，饿了就去找保安，困了就跳上快递柜。
entries.en: But Dafu had no idea he was the star of a story. He still came and went on his own schedule, finding the guard when he was hungry and jumping onto the parcel lockers when he was sleepy.

entries.zh: 下午四点多，大福又来了。
entries.en: A little after four, Dafu showed up again.

entries.zh: 和文章发布以前没什么不同。
entries.en: Just as he always had, long before the article.

entries.zh: 大福今天也在上班。
entries.en: Dafu's on duty today, too.

entries.zh: 文章发出去以后，还是有人问，林女士为什么没有把大福带回家。
entries.en: After the article came out, some people still asked why Lin Min hadn't taken Dafu home.

entries.zh: 也有人说，第一次知道一场救助并不一定要以收养结束。
entries.en: Others said they had never realized that a rescue didn't have to end in adoption.

entries.zh: 林女士没有成为大福的主人。
entries.en: Lin Min never became Dafu's owner.

entries.zh: 保安、投喂的居民和那些偶尔替它换水的人，也没有谁能够单独负责它的一生。
entries.en: The guard, the residents who fed him, the people who occasionally changed his water—none of them could take sole responsibility for the rest of his life.

entries.zh: 但大福还是活了下来，并且回到了熟悉的地方。
entries.en: But Dafu had survived and found his way back to a familiar place.

entries.zh: 救下一只猫以后，故事并不会立刻结束。
entries.en: Saving a cat doesn't mean the story ends there.

entries.zh: 至于大福，它还有明天的饭要吃，还有熟悉的地方要去。
entries.en: As for Dafu, there would be another meal tomorrow, and familiar places to visit.

entries.zh: 它的日子还在继续。
entries.en: His life goes on.

entries.zh: 文章发布以后，很多读者第一次知道，大福曾经伤得有多重。
entries.en: After the article was published, many readers learned for the first time just how badly Dafu had once been injured.

entries.zh: 也有人讨论，救下一只流浪猫，是不是就必须把它带回家。
entries.en: Some also discussed whether rescuing a stray cat meant having to take it home.

entries.zh: 林女士没有再作更多解释。正如她在采访里说的，给猫看病和收养是两回事。她能做的，是把大福送到医院；等到自己照顾不了，再另作安排。
entries.en: Lin Min offered no further explanation. As she had said in the interview, getting a cat medical care and adopting it were two separate things. What she could do was get Dafu to a hospital, then make other arrangements when she could no longer care for him herself.

entries.zh: —— 几天后 ——
entries.en: A few days later

entries.zh: 保安叔叔拿出手机，发了一条消息。
entries.en: The guard takes out his phone and sends a quick message.

entries.zh: 她愿意聊。我来给你们牵个线。
entries.en: She's happy to talk. I'll put you in touch.

entries.zh: 好，谢谢叔叔。
entries.en: Okay. Thank you.

entries.zh: 小凌的手机响了一声。是林敏发来的消息。
entries.en: Ling's phone buzzes. It's a message from Lin Min.

entries.zh: 明天下午三点，在槐安社区南门外的咖啡馆见林敏。
entries.en: Meet Lin Min at the café outside Huai’an Community’s south gate tomorrow at 3 p.m.

entries.zh: 前往咖啡馆
entries.en: Go to the café

entries.zh: 林敏，这儿有个记者，在打听大福以前的事。你看到了回我一条。
entries.en: Lin, there's a reporter here asking about Dafu's past. Text me back when you see this.

entries.zh: 行，没问题。
entries.en: Sure, no problem.

entries.zh: 你好，我是林敏。保安跟我说，你想问问大福的事。
entries.en: Hi, I'm Lin Min. The guard told me you wanted to ask about Dafu.

entries.zh: 你好，我是小凌，《此时》的记者。我今天在社区见到了大福，也跟保安聊了一会儿。想跟你确认一下它受伤、治疗，还有后来被接回来的一些细节。明天下午方便做个简短采访吗？
entries.en:
Hi, I'm Ling, a reporter with Here & Now. I met Dafu in the neighborhood today and talked to the guard for a bit. I'd like to confirm a few details about his injury, treatment, and how he was brought back afterward.

Would you have time for a short interview tomorrow afternoon?

entries.zh: 可以。我明天下午三点左右有空。南门外有家咖啡馆，我们在那儿见吧，平时挺安静的。
entries.en:
Sure.
I'm free around three tomorrow afternoon. There's a café just outside the south gate. Let's meet there. It's usually pretty quiet.

entries.zh: 好啊。方便把位置发我吗？
entries.en: Sounds good. Could you send me the location?

entries.zh: 槐安社区南门外的咖啡馆
entries.en: Café outside Huai'an Community South Gate

entries.zh: 就是这家。
entries.en: This is the one.

entries.zh: 收到。那明天下午三点见。谢谢！
entries.en: Got it. See you there at three tomorrow. Thanks!

entries.zh: 好，明天见。
entries.en: Okay, see you tomorrow.
